articles.title: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users
articles.summary: Security researchers at Dragos used two million fake AI requests to uncover serious vulnerabilities in the AI supply chain, finding at least three compromised providers, hundreds of stolen AWS keys, and marketplace resellers who were simply reading customer requests. OpenRouter responded by removing three providers and 125 endpoints. The article Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users appeared first on The Decoder.
articles.author: Matthias Bastian

articles.title: AI may not work like the human brain after all, scientists discover
articles.summary: AI may not think like the human brain after all, according to a striking new discovery that challenges how scientists understand artificial intelligence. Researchers found that even AI models that closely predict brain activity may rely on internal processes the brain doesn't use, raising important questions about their reliability in neuroscience research.

articles.title: Google's New Gemini 4 Neon Outperforms Claude Opus 5.5 on Several Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google's Gemini 4 model family continues its element-based naming convention, with Carbon, Hydrogen, Argon, and now, Neon.
articles.author: Supreeth Koundinya

articles.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
articles.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, which is nearly 2x faster than its sibling Carbon, outperforms it on most benchmarks and comes in at a significantly lower price.
